g.text: Global Event Query + Hard-RoI | Val | tau = 0.6
5 backbones x 4 cells; fixed epoch 4; seed 2026; original GMR parameters frozen
All values: %. Parentheses: gain versus same-backbone GMR (pp), subtracting displayed values. Bold: within-backbone best.
LoRA / Gaussian-RoI / 6D Saliency / candidate presence fusion: OFF. Baseline and Global-only are verified reused cells.
10 new Hard-only / Global+Hard runs; baseline: 0 new epochs. Standard data: 4,138 train / 465 val / 1,036 test.
Exploratory single-seed comparisons; no test checkpoint/threshold selection. Native FlashVTG score calibration and NMS retained.
